statements.impact_statement: The finding is attributed to nanobot-ai metadata 0.1.0, but the redirect-time SSRF behavior described by the advisory is not present in this candidate's web_fetch path. The fix commit 545294c62c0947da40eb5b65288aaf02b5fdf632 is an ancestor of the candidate revision f2173bbe3f9c887f2db118e35fc792485c2681dd, and the SHA-256 of nanobot/agent/tools/web.py and nanobot/security/network.py inside this image are identical to the D8 candidate already assessed: web.py 3026e04c5b066b7342c9645e2081daad7604f37aef9cd8c72b72f6eaf6443abd and network.py ecec72953ba3ed99b4921d2ba0951f0eecdf6297f3e429daa19545276f94aa24. Redirects remain manual, each hop is validated, and requests use the pinned-DNS transport.
statements.action_statement: This assessment applies only to this image ID. Re-evaluate if the web_fetch redirect or DNS-pinning code changes, if the nanobot-ai version metadata changes, or if the image is rebuilt from a different source revision. This is a draft technical assessment, not a waiver and not an operator approval.
